questions.topic: Shortest Distance Formula for Skew Lines
questions.question:
Find the shortest distance between the two skew lines in [Three-Dimensional Geometry]:
$$\vec{r}_1 = (\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}) + \lambda(\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}) \quad \text{and} \quad \vec{r}_2 = (4\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}) + \mu(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + \hat{k})$$
questions.explanation: Solve using rigorous mathematical proofs and transformations in Three-Dimensional Geometry.
tags: Shortest Distance Formula for Skew Lines

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.topic: Shortest Distance Formula for Skew Lines
questions.question:
Evaluate the integer value of the limit in [Three-Dimensional Geometry]:
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} \times 6$$
questions.solution: Using Taylor series $\sin x = x - \frac{x^3}{6} + O(x^5)$, we have $\frac{x - \sin x}{x^3} = \frac{1}{6} + O(x^2) \to \frac{1}{6}$. Multiplied by $6$, the value is $1$.
questions.explanation: Derive using rigorous mathematical theorems in Three-Dimensional Geometry.
tags: Shortest Distance Formula for Skew Lines
